o.text: Ultimately from Proto-Turkic *alkï- (“to bless, praise; to curse”) + -ış. Cognate with Turkish alkış, Bashkir алҡыш (alqış), Chuvash ылхан (ylh̬an, “curse”) etc.
Borrowed from Arabic أَسِير (ʔasīr). Doublet of əsir.
From təktanrıçı + -lıq. Cognate with Turkish tek tanrıcılık.
From Proto-Turkic *er-ti (“was”), third person past participle of Proto-Turkic *er- (“to be”).
